list.text: Whoa! What a surprise!\nI didn't expect to see anyone here!
I was conned into buying a SlowpokeTail. I feel sorry for the poor Pokémon.
You're headed to Azalea, are you?\nLet my Pokémon see if you are good enough to battle.
I'm not leaving until my Pokémon get tougher!
ZUBAT's Supersonic keeps confusing my Pokémon. I'm seriously upset about that!
I've practiced training my Pokémon, but I've practiced breathing fire many more times than that.
Don't try this at home, OK?
I roam far and wide in search of Pokémon.
Are you looking for Pokémon, too?\nThen you're my collecting rival!
Every Friday, you can hear Pokémon roars from deep inside the cave.
If a cave is clear then it's not scary.

lines: Notice that invisible character needs to be used here,
otherwise it has a small glitch where the user goes
behind the stair for a frame.
Check the second page of the event as well, as it is important!
